record.paper_title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
record.context_brief: Characterization of graphs by quorum coloring number
record.original_question: Characterize the graphs G for which the quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) equals 1, and characterize the graphs G for which ψ_q(G) is greater than 1. Here a quorum coloring of a graph G is a partition of V(G) into color classes such that for every vertex v, at least half of the vertices in the closed neighborhood N[v] have the same color as v; ψ_q(G) is the maximum number of color classes in such a coloring.

evidence.quote: Can you characterize the class of graphs for which ψq(G) = 1 or the class of graphs for which ψq(G) > 1?

In this paper, we give answers to four open problems stated in 2013 by Hedetniemi, Hedetniemi, Laskar and Mulder. In particular, we show that there is no good characterization of the graphs G with ψq(G) = 1 nor for those with ψq(G) > 1 unlessP̸ =NP∩ co−NP .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a finite simple graph. For a vertex v ∈ V, let N[v] denote the closed neighborhood of v (i.e., v together with its neighbors). A partition π = {V_1, V_2, …, V_k} of V into nonempty color classes is called a quorum coloring of G if for every vertex v ∈ V, at least half of the vertices of N[v] lie in the same class of π as v. The quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) is defined as the maximum number k of classes over all quorum colorings of G.

Provide a characterization of the class of graphs G for which ψ_q(G) = 1, and a characterization of the class of graphs G for which ψ_q(G) > 1. (Equivalently, decide whether such "good" structural characterizations exist.)
artifact.status_search_result: The problem has been resolved in the negative sense: it is shown that there is no good characterization of the graphs G with ψ_q(G) = 1, nor of those with ψ_q(G) > 1, unless P = NP ∩ co-NP. This is established in the work titled "Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs" (RAIRO - Operations Research, 2021), and related complexity results appear in companion papers on the complexity of quorum-coloring problems.

status_evidence.title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs | RAIRO - Operations Research
status_evidence.snippet: We show that there is no good characterization of the graphs G with ψq(G) = 1 nor for those with ψq(G) > 1 unless P = NP ∩ co-NP.
status_evidence.claim: The two characterization questions admit no good characterization unless P = NP ∩ co-NP.

status_evidence.title: On the complexity of some quorum colorings problems of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Complexity results on deciding quorum coloring properties.
status_evidence.claim: Hardness results support the impossibility of simple characterizations.
